Benefits Financial Analyst

Summary:
Do you love thinking analytically? Are you passionate about using your financial knowledge to navigate complex challenges? Just as our customers find value in Apple products, the Finance group finds value for both Apple and its shareholders. As part of this group, you'll play an integral role in ensuring our day-to-day financial health. You and your team will support Apple's growth, both top and bottom line, by applying the same level of innovation toward financial matters as we do toward our products and services. You'll also collaborate with Apple teams across the world to develop more effective investment strategies and risk management. Finance is essential to upholding our global commitment to excellence, and it is directly responsible for shaping the company's future. Join us, and you'll have an important role in continuing Apple's legacy of efficiency and success.


Description:
This role offers a unique opportunity to gain visibility into how we support the Apple employee experience globally to ensure our benefits meet the evolving needs of our employees and the strategic goals of Apple. The team manages the corporate monthly Benefits forecast processes, including quarter-end reporting and the annual plan. In this role you'll analyze financial performance and present business drivers to senior leadership, partner with cross-functional teams throughout Apple, and drive continuous improvement in process, reporting, and data analytics, including leveraging emerging AI technologies to enable more efficient consolidation and more insightful reporting. The role requires great organizational skills, solid business acumen, strong analytical skill, exceptional interpersonal skills, and an uncompromising attention to detail.

Minimum Qualifications:
3+ years of experience in finance, financial planning and analysis, or a related field.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.


Preferred Qualifications:
FP&A experience, including forecasting, variance analysis, and month/quarter-end close processes.
Exceptionally organized, with meticulous attention to detail.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to distill complexity into clear narratives for senior leadership.
Strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Proficient in Excel; experience with Tableau and Adaptive Planning a plus.

Familiarity with emerging AI tools, with a track record of applying them to drive process improvement.

Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-paced environments where priorities shift and precision still matters.

Skilled at building cross-functional partnerships across all levels of the organization.

Self-motivated, with a continuous-improvement mindset.

Responsibilities:
Support and help drive the corporate monthly Benefits forecast processes, quarter-end reporting, and annual plan.

Analyze financial performance, break down variances into key drivers, and present business drivers to senior leadership.

Maintain business partner relationships with dozens of global contacts across the Benefits team, outside vendors, and various other stakeholders to regularly track updates to benefit programs and provide input on the design and performance of benefit programs.

Partner with cross-functional teams to consolidate and validate forecast inputs, prepare executive-ready reporting and commentary, and ensure accuracy across deliverables.

Identify and apply opportunities to use emerging AI tools to reduce manual work and enable more efficient consolidation and more insightful reporting.

Drive ad hoc financial analysis and projects in support of business and leadership goals.
